newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro Disney welcomes single currency.
newsitem.headline: Euro Disney welcomes single currency.

text.p: Euro Disney chairman Philippe Bourguignon said on Tuesday that the theme park operator welcomed the creation of a single European currency.

"We await the Euro impatiently," he told a news conference. He said it would be easier to promote the Disneyland Paris theme park with one price throughout Europe. "To sell in the same currency would be a big advantage for us," he said.
"At a psychological level, it would help bring down barriers to spending," he said, adding that there was a strong barrier in France at 200 francs.
The conversion into euros is expected to ease ingrained consumer resistance to certain price levels, he said.
Chief financial officer Xavier de Mezerac said the company had set up a committee to study the impact of a single currency, scheduled for 1999, on the company's accounting and on its price strategy.
The largest number of visitors to Disneyland Paris are French and Germans, who together represent nearly 60 percent of the total.
